output.title: Ease off back, quads next week
output.rationale: back, quads have been sore or painful. Remove Back squat (high bar) for a week; other exercises for the area drop half their sets and everything else trains normally.

output.title: Or: a higher-rep week for back, quads
output.rationale: If back, quads ache with heavy loads but not with high reps, keep every exercise and set next week but switch the ones that work the area to higher reps with lighter loads. Pick this or the targeted deload, not both.
